dialogue.content: おはようございます。今日はよろしくお願いします。お時間になったら始めさせて頂きます、
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for coming today. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: はい、どうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。初めに差し支えなければあなたの年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming today. To begin, if you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは、40歳女です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。今日どんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、父親との関係性についてです
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s about my relationship with my father.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しく聞かせていただいてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.content: 昔から父とは確執があり、ただもう両親も歳ですので、
dialogue.English: I've had a difficult relationship with my father for a long time, but now that my parents are getting older...

dialogue.content: ええ、はい、
dialogue.English: Yes, I see.

dialogue.content: 嫌いという感情が心の中から消したいのですが、
dialogue.English: I want to get rid of this feeling of dislike I have for him, but...

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 消さなくてもいいような気もするし、もやもやしています
dialogue.English: at the same time, I feel like maybe I don't have to get rid of it. I just feel conflicted.

dialogue.content: はい、そうだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you've been feeling.

dialogue.content: やるせないお気持ちになりますね、
dialogue.English: That must be a very frustrating feeling.

dialogue.content: もう少しあなたのことについて知りたいのですが、お父様とどんなことがあったのか話せることでいいので教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to know a bit more about you. Only what you’re comfortable sharing—could you tell me what kinds of things happened with your father?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、良好な関係を保てない気持ちが、自分はだめなやつだなっておもいます
dialogue.English: Well... The fact that I can't maintain a good relationship with him makes me feel like there's something wrong with me.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように自分を責めていらっしゃるのですね、お辛かったですね、
dialogue.English: I see—so you’ve been blaming yourself that way. That must have been painful.

dialogue.content: はい、父親とは子供のころから嫌いで、昔ながらの頑固おやじみたいな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, I've disliked my father since I was a child. He's like a traditional, stubborn old man.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、例えばどんなところが嫌だったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what kinds of things did you dislike about him?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、話し合いが出来ない
dialogue.English: Well... we can't have a proper discussion.

dialogue.content: 自分の意見を押し付けてくる
dialogue.English: He forces his opinions on me.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね、あなたが何かを言っても聞いてくれない、、そんな状況が多かったのでしょうか、
dialogue.English: I see. So was it often the case that he wouldn't listen even if you tried to say something?

dialogue.content: 監視する
dialogue.English: He's always watching me.

dialogue.content: ええ、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、そんな印象です
dialogue.English: Yes… that’s the impression I have.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、小さい頃からそんな状況の中ずっと悩んでこられたのですね、
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been struggling with this situation ever since you were little.

dialogue.content: その状態は今も同じなのでしょうか？あなたに対して
dialogue.English: Is the situation still the same now, in how he treats you?

dialogue.content: 悩むって程ではないけどずっとモヤモヤしています。今も同じです、たぶん性格が合わないんだと思うんですけど、ねちっこいところが本当に嫌いで嫌いで
dialogue.English: I wouldn't say I'm struggling with it, but I've always felt this uneasiness. It's still the same now. I think our personalities just don't match. I really, really can't stand his nagging nature.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、頭の隅でずっと何かがモヤモヤしている、そんな気持ちだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see. So it's been like a persistent, unsettled feeling in the back of your mind.

dialogue.content: そうですね、親ももう年だからいい加減この気持ちをどこかへ納めたいのですが、どうしたいいのか
dialogue.English: That's right. My parents are getting old, so I feel I need to put these feelings to rest somehow, but I don't know how.

dialogue.content: 普段お父様とはどんなお話をされたりするのですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do you usually talk about with your father?

dialogue.content: 行きたがってしまいましたね、失礼しました。
dialogue.English: I seem to have jumped ahead. My apologies.

dialogue.content: 話はほとんどしないです、メールのやりとりが少し
dialogue.English: We hardly talk at all. We just exchange a few emails.

dialogue.content: ええ、お父様の年齢を考えて、あなたがこれまでずっとモヤモヤしていることをどこかにしまいたいのだけど、それも難しいし、どうしていいかわからない、そんな風に思われてるのですね、
dialogue.English: I see. So considering your father's age, you want to put these long-held, unsettled feelings to rest, but it's difficult and you don't know what to do. That's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます、そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me. I understand.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, that's it...

dialogue.content: ええ、そのモヤモヤが少しでも無くなるようにあなたのお力になりたいと思います、
dialogue.English: Yes. I would like to help you resolve even a little bit of that uneasiness.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 一緒に考えていきましょう、
dialogue.English: Let’s think it through together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、お父様とはどんなメールのやり取りをされてるのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of emails do you and your father exchange?

dialogue.content: 父の日に荷物を送るのと、農作物を送ってくれるのでそれのやり取りをするくらいです
dialogue.English: It's mostly just about me sending him a package on Father's Day, and him sending me produce he's grown.

dialogue.content: 基本的にお互いの話はしないですね
dialogue.English: We basically don’t talk about each other’s lives.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 直接は話したいしないけれど、お互いに荷物を送り合ったりすることがあるのですね、
dialogue.English: So you don't talk directly, but you do exchange packages with each other.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それくらいはしないと、という気持ちで
dialogue.English: Yes, it's more out of a feeling that I should at least do that much.

dialogue.content: ええ、家族として関係が明るくなるようにあなた自身が前向きに行動されているように思いました、
dialogue.English: Yes, it sounds to me like you are taking positive steps to brighten your relationship as a family.

dialogue.content: ちなみにお母様との関係はいかがなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how is your relationship with your mother?

dialogue.content: そうですね、それくらいはやらないと、自分の気持ちの為という感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel like I have to do at least that much, for my own peace of mind.

dialogue.content: 母親とはいい関係セだと思っていたのですが、母親は父親とうまくいっていないので、幼少期からずっと悪口を聞かせられていました
dialogue.English: I thought I had a good relationship with my mother, but she doesn't get along with my father, so I've had to listen to her speak ill of him ever since I was young.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it's been.

dialogue.content: それに、最近嫌気がさしてきたというか、、そんな感じはあります。ただ、母親とは頻繁にやり取りしてます、まあ、それも父親の悪口なんですけどね笑
dialogue.English: And lately, I've been getting tired of it... I feel that way. But I do communicate with my mother frequently, though it's mostly about her complaining about my father (laughs).

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そうでしたか、
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what's been happening.

dialogue.content: ずっとお父様の悪口を書いているととてもしんどいですよね、
dialogue.English: Hearing constant badmouthing of your father must be very draining.

dialogue.content: いまご両親は一緒に暮らしているのですか？
dialogue.English: Are your parents living together now?

dialogue.content: いいえ、両親は父の実家で暮らしており、遠方です
dialogue.English: No, they live together in my father's family home, which is far away.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お母様からするとあなたはとても頼りにされてるのですね、
dialogue.English: It sounds like your mother relies on you a great deal.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、、母親は気持ちがとても弱い人なので気にしています
dialogue.English: Yes… My mother is very emotionally fragile, so I worry about her.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように感じてらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see—that’s how you feel.

dialogue.content: あなたから、とても家族を想う気持ちを拝見しました
dialogue.English: I can see how deeply you care about your family.

dialogue.content: ちなみにご兄弟などはいらっしゃるのですか？差し支えなければ教え頂けますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, do you have any siblings? If you don't mind sharing.

dialogue.content: 弟が一人、それも遠方です
dialogue.English: I have one younger brother; he also lives far away.

dialogue.content: 教えて頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.content: 弟様はこのような状況をご存知なのですか？
dialogue.English: Is your brother aware of this situation?

dialogue.content: 弟は関心ないです。いってもそーなんだー、くらいで、なにも
dialogue.English: My brother isn't interested. Even if I tell him, he just says, "Oh, is that so?" and that's it.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうでしたか、それは困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 弟はよくやってくれてます。孫を連れて毎年盆正月帰省しています
dialogue.English: My brother does his part well, though. He brings his children to visit them every year for the Obon and New Year holidays.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうでしたか、家族との時間を作れてるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So he does make time for family.

dialogue.content: 今時珍しいともうくらい真面目で、むしろ助かっています
dialogue.English: He's so dutiful, it's rare these days. I'm actually grateful for it.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、家族の絆を感じました、
dialogue.English: Yes, I can feel the strong family bond.

dialogue.content: やはりご両親も遠い場所で暮らしているとのことなので、なかなかその環境からも難しいところがあるのかな、と思いました
dialogue.English: Since your parents live far away, I imagine the distance makes things difficult as well.

dialogue.content: 父以外は良好ですね。うちは父が孤立してる感はあります。
dialogue.English: The relationships are good, except for with my father. It feels like he's the one who is isolated in our family.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お父様は家族のことについてどう思ってると思われますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think your father feels about the family?

dialogue.content: うーん、父ってよくわからないんですよね、何考えているんだか、本当に謎で
dialogue.English: Hmm, I really don’t understand my father. I have no idea what he’s thinking—he’s a real mystery.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われるのですね、
dialogue.English: I see—that’s how it seems to you.

dialogue.content: わたしがこれまでお話しを聞いて思ったことですが
dialogue.English: Based on what you've told me so far...

dialogue.content: あなたのお父様も同じく家族を大切にする気持ちがあるのではないかと思いました。
dialogue.English: ...I got the impression that your father also has a deep sense of care for his family.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: Yes, that might be true.

dialogue.content: 気持ちはあるけど、噛み合わないというか
dialogue.English: He may have the feelings, but we just don't seem to connect.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、遠方の中でも荷物を送り合ったり、などなかなか簡単にできることではないのかなと思いました、
dialogue.English: Yes, it seems to me that exchanging packages despite the distance is not something that can be done so easily.

dialogue.content: そこがなかなか難しいですよね
dialogue.English: That's the difficult part, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうなんでしょうか、周りは皆んなやってますので、普通かと
dialogue.English: Is that so? Everyone around me does it, so I thought it was normal.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか？小さい頃からあなた自身がモヤモヤしていて父親との関係があまり良くない中、
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Considering you've had this unsettled feeling and a not-so-good relationship with your father since childhood...

dialogue.content: 何年も経ってでもやり取りが続いているのは簡単にできることではないと私は思いましたよ
dialogue.English: ...I feel that continuing to stay in touch after so many years is not an easy thing to do.

dialogue.content: それくらいしかむしろ交流がないんですよね、ないから、せめて荷物を送るくらいで済ませる感じ
dialogue.English: It's just that there's really no other interaction. Because there isn't, it feels like sending packages is the least I can do.

dialogue.content: ええ、ですがそのやり取りがとても大切なのではないかと思いました、
dialogue.English: Yes, but I thought that exchange itself might be very important.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それをしなければ本当に疎遠です
dialogue.English: That's true. If we didn't do that, we'd be completely estranged.

dialogue.content: ええ、お父様が何考えてるかわからない、だけど嫌いだったら荷物など送りすらしないと思いました、
dialogue.English: I see. You don't know what your father is thinking, but I imagine if you truly disliked him, you wouldn't even send him packages.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、素直な想いがなかなか伝わらないのがもどかしいですよね、
dialogue.English: Yes, it must be frustrating when your true feelings don't get across.

dialogue.content: 父は人の気持ちがわからない人なんだと思います。なんか一方通行というか
dialogue.English: I think my father is someone who doesn't understand other people's feelings. It feels like a one-way street.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、そのように思われるのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, I see—that’s how you see it.

dialogue.content: 何考えてるかわからないというか
dialogue.English: It's more that I don't know what he's thinking.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お父様とお話しする機会を設けるというのはどうなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What about creating an opportunity to talk with your father?

dialogue.content: 何を話すんでしょうか
dialogue.English: What would I talk about?

dialogue.content: あなたがわたしに上手にお話ししてくださったように、お父様への気持ちを話してみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Just as you've so clearly explained things to me, how about trying to tell your father how you feel?

dialogue.content: 何考えてるかわからないって、何度も言ってますけどね笑
dialogue.English: I've told him many times that I don't know what he's thinking (laughs).

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, you have.

dialogue.content: もしかすると、お父様も家族の中で孤立していて素直に話すのが難しいかもしれないですよね、
dialogue.English: Perhaps your father also feels isolated in the family and finds it difficult to speak honestly.

dialogue.content: だから訳がわからないですよね
dialogue.English: That's why it's so confusing.

dialogue.content: 話しても、え？ってことがかなりあって意味不明だし
dialogue.English: Even when we talk, there are so many moments where I'm just like, "What?" It doesn't make any sense.

dialogue.content: 理解なくてもいいのかもしれないけど、なんかモヤモヤするというか
dialogue.English: Maybe I don't need to understand him, but it just leaves me with this unsettled feeling.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、例えばなのですが、あなたがここでお話ししてくださったように本当は今まで嫌なこともあったししんどいこともあったけれど、本当はいい関係を保ちたいと思ってるし、家族として大切なことを伝えたとしたら
dialogue.English: I see. For example, what if you were to tell him what you've told me here—that while there have been unpleasant and difficult times, you truly want to have a good relationship and that he's important to you as family...

dialogue.content: どんなことが起こりそうですか？
dialogue.English: what do you think would happen?

dialogue.content: 家族として大切な気持ちは荷物に小さな手紙を入れて伝えられると思います。
dialogue.English: I think I could convey my feelings about him being important as family by putting a short note in one of the packages.

dialogue.content: それはとても素敵ですね、
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful idea.

dialogue.content: そしたら、多分父は大喜びで、たくさんの荷物を送ってくると思います笑
dialogue.English: If I did that, he would probably be overjoyed and send me a ton of stuff in return (laughs).

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように思われますか、
dialogue.English: I see, you think so?

dialogue.content: よくお父様のことを理解されてるのですね
dialogue.English: You seem to understand your father very well.

dialogue.content: なんかそう言うのいらないんだけどなーーって思いながら受け取りますけどね。友達ならわかるけど家族だし
dialogue.English: I'd accept it while thinking, "I don't really need all this..." I could understand it if we were friends, but we're family.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、お父様もとても嬉しいけど素直じゃない、そんなかんじなのですね、直接話して明日から全部変えることは難しいかもしれないけれど、
dialogue.English: I see. So it's like your father would be very happy but isn't able to express it directly. It might be difficult to change everything overnight by talking directly, but...

dialogue.content: 送りたいから送っているわけで、「ありがとう」だけでいいんだけど、って思っちゃいます
dialogue.English: He's sending it because he wants to, so I just feel like a simple "thank you" should be enough.

dialogue.content: ええ、あなた自身もそのように思われるのですね、お父様も直接ありがとう、というのは恥ずかしいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, and that's how you feel as well. Perhaps your father finds it embarrassing to say "thank you" directly, too?

dialogue.content: 家族だからこそ言えないことってあるのかもしれないですよね、
dialogue.English: Sometimes there are things that are harder to say precisely because you are family.

dialogue.content: そうですねー
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: あなたがここでお話しして考えてくださったように荷物に小さな手紙を添えてみる、このような積み重ねがすこしづつ未来をいい方向に変えてくれるのではないかと思いました
dialogue.English: I think that building on these small actions, like adding a little note to a package as you've considered here, could gradually change things for the better in the future.

dialogue.content: いかがですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね、楽天でポチるだけではなく、一手間で少しずつ伝えてみようと思いました
dialogue.English: You're right. Instead of just clicking to order on Rakuten, I'll try to convey my feelings little by little by adding that small extra step.

dialogue.content: 聞いてくださり、少し気持ちが楽になりました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening. I feel a little more at ease now.

dialogue.content: とても大切な気づきですよね、そのように聞けて嬉しく思います。
dialogue.English: That’s a very important realization. I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: 家族を大切に想う深いお気持ち、伝わるように願っております。
dialogue.English: I hope your deep feelings of care for your family get through to him.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間でしたね、今日は大切なお気持ちをお話ししてくださりありがとうございました
dialogue.English: It looks like our time is almost up. Thank you for sharing such important feelings with me today.

dialogue.content: またぜひここでお待ちしているので、お話聞かせてください
dialogue.English: I'll be here for you again, so please feel free to come back and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: またきます
dialogue.English: I'll come again.

dialogue.content: はい、いつでもお待ちしてます。それではこちらで失礼致します。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll be waiting. Well then, I'll sign off here.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした。貴重なお時間ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work. I appreciate you taking the time for this.)

dialogue.content: 失礼します、またお願いします
dialogue.English: Goodbye, and thank you again.
